source: seed — Aug 2026 research comparables; the daily verify agent keeps this file current

listings.name: Cafe and Ice Cream Shop
listings.notes: Confidential sale. Long lease, low rent, growth potential cited by the agent. Closest active listing to the Polwarth/Merchiston corridor.

listings.name: Immaculate Coffee Shop
listings.notes: Commercial kitchen plus large basement. Rent runs well above the £14k Ashley Terrace comparable — a reminder that Bruntsfield commands a premium.

listings.name: 20-Seat Restaurant
listings.notes: Under offer — useful only as a size/rent benchmark (20 covers, £12k rent, low overheads).

listings.name: Bennitos Cafe
listings.notes: One of the few listings disclosing real figures: £150k turnover, £25k profit (17%), £18k rent. The closest real-world validation of the model — and a valuation anchor for what a £40k asking price buys.

listings.name: The Dower House Cafe
listings.notes: Established 3.5 years, 4.7 TripAdvisor rating, 11 indoor + 30 outdoor covers, shared building with a community trust. Further out but a useful going-concern template.
